included: Production Go source, original Apache-2.0/BSD licenses, and four targeted security regressions; upstream test fixtures and examples omitted.

changes.backport: Reject empty padded CBC buffers before indexing.
Enforce the upstream 10000-level scanner bound before recursive JSON decoding.
Use the upstream 4096-bit RSA bound and cheap prime-product checks before RSA validation; reject private JWK/EPK header parameters. The bound is fixed because Caddy exposes no reason to raise it.
Require patched Go1.26.10 and x/crypto0.58.0; remove upstream test-only dependencies.

text_normalization: CRLF to LF; scoped .gitattributes enforces identical checkout bytes.
